extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism layer; mechanistic statements are bounded to indirect/phenotypic/hypothesis evidence and do not overclaim direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: B1 is a rational LL-37/BMAP-27 hybrid with high predicted helicity, cationic charge, and hydrophobicity; the paper uses these physicochemical features to support membrane-interaction plausibility, not a direct mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No membrane permeabilization or binding assay was performed for B1 in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: B1 has phenotypic antibiofilm activity in the Calgary biofilm device assay, with MBEC/MBECb values and viable-biofilm-cell percentages reported against resistant S. aureus and P. aeruginosa.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports antibiofilm effect, not the molecular mechanism of biofilm eradication.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The synergy discussion proposes membrane disruption and possible efflux-pump effects as explanations for antibiotic potentiation, while explicitly leaving exact combination mechanisms unstudied.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct efflux, membrane-entry, DNA/RNA/protein synthesis, or target-binding assay was reported for the combinations.
